resources.string: Review how SignPDF handles document and advertising data.

SignPDF Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-09-03

1. Documents and images
PDFs and images are processed on your device to open PDFs, unlock protected PDFs, sign, annotate, convert images to PDF, merge PDFs, manage, extract or split pages, and save results. Document contents and PDF passwords are not uploaded to a server. Results are saved as new PDFs without overwriting the original.

2. Recent files and saved signatures
Recent file names, formats, Android file URIs, and signatures saved during full access may be stored locally on your device for convenience. You can remove these local records by deleting the relevant item or app data.

3. Advertising and the 60-minute reward
Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob) may show banner and rewarded interstitial ads. Google advertising services may process IP addresses, device and advertising identifiers, ad interactions, diagnostics, and performance information for ad delivery, measurement, and fraud prevention. Where required, Google UMP provides consent and ad privacy choices. Finishing the rewarded interstitial removes task and advanced-tool limits and hides the banner for 60 minutes. Reward start and expiry times are stored locally on the device.

4. Free usage limit
Without an active ad reward, users can complete up to 10 successful output creation or save operations per monthly cycle. Usage count and reset timing are stored locally on the device.

5. Data sale
SignPDF does not sell document contents or personal information to advertisers.

6. Children
SignPDF is not specifically designed for children.

7. Security and limitations
SignPDF is a document editing utility and is not a certified electronic-signature authority, electronic-contract certification service, or legal identity-verification service. Check the save location and recipients when handling sensitive documents.

8. Changes and contact
This policy may be updated when app features, SDKs, or applicable policies change. For privacy questions, use the developer contact email listed on Google Play.
